thread:
Ivy Lopez: Heads-up: trivy surfaced a medium glibc finding in our slimroot image. I want a quick rebuild + tighten signing posture this week. Thinking Thu 22:00 PT. No panic yet but let's plan. @security-oncall @Rahul Kapoor

Rahul Kapoor: Agreed. Recommend: minimal image-signer SA with only kms.cryptoSign on the signing key + storage.objects.create for attestations. Enforce IAM Conditions (repo=ci-repo && job=release) and short-lived tokens (1h). Avoid granting keystore admin to anyone.

Jen Park: Audit requirements: make sure AsymmetricSign calls are logged and retained 1y. Also add an alert: any non-success AsymmetricSign for the signer SA OR >1 AsymmetricSign/hour from unknown principals. Example Stackdriver filter pasted below.

security-oncall: Two questions: can CI create ephemeral key versions per run? If not, what's fallback? Also need a forensic plan for already-signed artifacts.

Ivy Lopez: Ephemeral idea: CI create key version, sign, then disable. Might hit KMS quotas. Alternate: single asymmetric key protected by IAM Conditions + OIDC claim checks. Pre-warm key versions if we go per-run.

Rahul Kapoor: Confirmed: GCP KMS has rate limits on key version creation. For a one-off rebuild that's fine; for frequent jobs use single-key + strict IAM. I'll add an OPA blocklist hook so security can quickly block digests.

Jen Park: Stackdriver filter (paste):
```
logName="projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersionService.AsymmetricSign"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"image-signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```
Alert: trigger on count_nonzero(status.code != 0)[1h] > 0 or count(AsymmetricSign[1h]) > 5 from unknown principals.

security-oncall: Runbook checklist request: preflight vuln list, RBAC change, KMS plan, attestation export to locked bucket, canary plan, alerting + retention. If exploit seen: revoke SA, disable key version, push digest to OPA blocklist, rollback. I'll own triage.

Ivy Lopez: Volunteers: I'll own rebuild + attestations. Rahul does RBAC + blocker hook. Jen does logging & alerts. ops-bot: open a maintenance ticket and schedule window.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-2026-777: "slimroot quick rebuild + signing hardening" scheduled Thu 2026-03-26 22:00 PT.

Ivy Lopez: Thanks all. I'll open the runbook PR and tag people. Post any blockers here. :lock:
